counting_rules: An appearance is a programme entry at one edition. A repeated presentation at another event remains separate.
Published lightning blocks remain one entry unless their sub-talks are separately indexed.
Breaks, registration and most social activities are omitted. Named introduction sessions retain kind other.
Indexed means the selected programme scope was reconciled with source entries; it does not mean media are complete or playable.
Programme date is not proof of delivery. Publication and retrieval dates are separate.
Edition language lists describe available source languages; they do not promise recording or subtitle languages.

research_regions.result: Multiple programmes indexed; other historical editions remain source only.
RustCamp 2015 and RustConf 2016/2017 have partial historical records. RustConf 2026 and TokioConf have selected programs indexed. Rust Belt Rust retains TLS access gaps.
RustChinaConf named 2026 sessions indexed; RustCon Asia, Rust.Tokyo, Rust India and RUSTAsia retain source or access gaps.
Rust Latam 2019 indexed. Rust Brasil community event listings were searched; meetups were not recast as a conference archive.
Rust Forge 2025 conference talks indexed; its workshops and tours are not yet indexed.
Rust Africa community and campus events were searched; no separate conference programme was verified in this pass. This is a search gap, not evidence that none exists.

limits: An initial source-checked draft; community and speaker review is pending.
No complete world conference, speaker bibliography or recording-availability claim.
No video playback, transcript accuracy or full-paper reading is asserted.
Original materials keep their own rights; this collection links metadata and does not relicense them.
Missing dates, authors and profiles remain null or explicit gaps.
Current EuroRust data and immutable snapshots remain separate.
The 2026-10-16 batch adds RustCamp 2015 and RustConf 2016/2017. Other record-level review dates remain unchanged; the file date does not renew every source check.

maintenance.future_programmes: Recheck after programme announcements and near the event.
maintenance.historical_archives: Check changed or reported links before editing records.
maintenance.contributions: Submit an edition, missing material or correction with its primary source.
